title: Concept: The dependency audit step is left unconfigured
description: composer.json declares a composer.json with no `config.audit` block, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a composer.json with no `config.audit` block.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a composer.json with no `config.audit` block.
